look_here_first: Look for grayish woolly stems and leaves with small papery clustered heads; inspect lower leaf wool, phyllary color and head arrangement; do not decide species based on scent alone.
photo_note: One attributed provisional species-recognition photograph; detailed diagnostic anatomy, synonym concepts and county-native screening incomplete.
identification_caution: Maryland original image; compare with Pseudognaphalium canescens and other cudweeds in Central Texas.
